name: Paper Document Organization
description: Creates a filing system for household documents including financial records, legal documents, medical files, warranties, and ongoing paperwork. Covers physical filing structure, retention schedules by document type, and a workflow for processing incoming paper. Use when the user asks about organizing paperwork, setting up a filing system, document retention periods, or managing household paperwork flow. Do NOT use for digital file organization, business document management, or general decluttering (use decluttering-method).
